title: NAB Qantas Rewards Signature: 40,000 QFF Points + $200 Cashback with $5,000 Spend in 90 Days, $449 Annual Fee @ NAB
body:
Deal: NAB Qantas Rewards Signature: 40,000 QFF Points + $200 Cashback with $5,000 Spend in 90 Days, $449 Annual Fee @ NAB

[Kden] It's just disappointment after disappointment today
[lawyerz] lol exactly what i said under my breath when i saw these 'deals'
[undadog] doesnt feel like that long ago when there were ateast 40k qantas points on offer with no annual fee…
i still remember that 150k QP offer with ANZ black back in the day… those were the days…
[gembel] once they realise they're not getting new customers, they'll start increasing the bonuses again.
westpac is smart to keep the bonuses high, so all new customers will go to them
[poormansfriedchicken] recently rejected by westpac they are careful on who to let in
[LikezDaBargainz] Nab cards are the worst now since the changes, I'm ditching mine as of this month
[FrugalityMaximus] Same. Just have to bring all the bills attached to it across and then I'm done with them.
[LikezDaBargainz] When you look at how much nab earnt last earnings, it makes sense why, they are greedy af
[kokoikaka] Bonus points are not available to customers who currently hold, or have held, any personal NAB Qantas Rewards Credit Card in the last 36 months
Oh no it's now 36 months cooling period. RIP churning
[ozzieozzieozzie] Interesting… the Velocity card states 24 months.
[Ash-Say] Have current points earning also been reduced for existing customers?
[iMagoo] Another disappointing offer following the recent credit card surcharge changes.
Genuine question, why post it? It sucks, it’s not a bargain.
[Kden] Saves people looking for offers manually.
Also some might still consider it to be better than nothing. If you can get the annual fee refunded (e.g. through a downgrade), I suppose it still is.
[jaygee] They're really taking the piss with that annual fee
[Willyslicks] low fee card not considered a reward card?
[ThePointsGuru] If you log in to your NAB account, it shows a better offer
Up to 80,000 bonus Qantas Points and $200 cashback​
50,000 bonus points and $200 cashback when you apply for a NAB Qantas Rewards Signature Card, are approved and spend $5,000 on everyday purchases within the first 90 days of account opening and 30,000 bonus points when you keep your card for over 12 months.
However, the offer until 30th Sep was 100K + 30K over 2 years and $250 cashback.
[I like GoodDeals] These posts are like Rubbing salt on the wounds
